title: Superhuman Protocol on Long Island | Apex Performance
metaDescription: Experience the certified Superhuman Protocol at Apex Performance in Bohemia, Long Island. Combine PEMF, oxygen training and TheraLight 360 red light in one advanced performance and recovery protocol.
heroCopy: Magnetism. Oxygen. Light. In the correct time sequence, every time. Apex Performance & Recovery is the first facility for advanced performance technology on Long Island to deliver the certified three-step protocol under one roof.
introKicker: Put it in the correct order
introBody: The Superhuman Protocol is a three-phase cycle engineered to prime your body with PEMF, flood it with oxygen, then amplify the results with TheraLight 360.
It is not random and it is not guesswork. Each phase is sequenced to support the next biological response.

faqs.question: How long does a Superhuman Protocol session take?
faqs.answer: The full protocol typically takes about 30–45 minutes from start to finish.

faqs.question: Do I need to be fit to do EWOT?
faqs.answer: No. EWOT (Exercise with Oxygen Therapy) is suitable for most fitness levels. It's designed to improve oxygen delivery and boost energy, even for those not at peak fitness.

faqs.question: How often should I do the protocol?
faqs.answer: Some clients come weekly, while others integrate it multiple times per week depending on recovery and performance goals.

faqs.question: Can I do individual therapies instead of the full protocol?
faqs.answer: Yes. Red Light Therapy is available as a standalone option.

faqs.question: Is this therapy invasive or painful?
faqs.answer: No, the Superhuman Protocol is non-invasive and painless. The therapies are designed to be comfortable, with no downtime required.
